one_line: One action in close-up first, then the same action child after child, with a voiceover that names the problem.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close-up: a hand presses a round white light on a mint-green stall door; it glows. Voiceover (transcript, garbled): it is embarrassing she has not shown this until now. 0:02 dissolve to a girl at a stall. No text.
q1_hook.why: A voice from 0:00 that admits she should have shown this earlier implies value and opens a gap (H4, H5), and one clear action, pressing a light on a stall door, is understood without words (S1, F5). There is no written hook, so it works only with sound (against H6, T3).

beats.what: Close-up: a hand presses the round light on a stall door; the light glows
beats.why: The whole product action in 2 s

beats.what: Dissolve; a girl presses it and goes in; a second girl waits at the door
beats.why: The problem is told while the action repeats

beats.what: Dissolve; a boy presses the light and goes in; voice: "this is our simple solution" (transcript)
beats.why: The solution is named over a new child

beats.what: Two boys in football shirts, one presses the light; voice gives the rule (transcript)
beats.why: The rule is explained as it is used

beats.what: More children, two faces covered by heart stickers; voice: it became a game (transcript)
A boy in a blue shirt presses the light and waits; voice: it works great (transcript)
beats.why: Ends on the action and the verdict

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none. The caption has no question or ask; it is a useful idea a teacher might send to a colleague.
q2_flow.why: The opening confession opens a loop that the voiceover answers by 0:11 (H5), and a new child pressing the light about every 3 s is a steady rhythm (R3, E2). The 24 s length fits one repeated demo (R2). It is a tip a gan teacher would send to a colleague (R5).

q3_cta.what: None. No spoken or written ask, no product name, no link. The caption is one line about demand for the light.
q3_cta.why: No ask and no product name mean a viewer who wants one must guess where to find it, so interest cannot turn into action (against C6, C7). It still works as a useful idea to send to a colleague (R5).

q4_shown.what: A hand pressing a round light on a stall door 0:00-0:02; then six different children, mostly from behind, press it and enter or wait, 0:02-0:23, the light glowing when pressed; two children's faces covered by heart stickers. No product name, price or shop.
q4_shown.why: The product is in action from the first frame (S1), and repeated use by many children is the proof that it works for different kids (R3). Faces are hidden by backs and stickers (S5). Nothing says what it is called or where to buy it (C7).

q5_edit.what: About 8 clips joined by cross-dissolves (at about 2, 9, 14 and 18 s), about 3 s each, static or lightly handheld at child height. Voiceover from 0:00 to the end; no text. Ends with a boy waiting at the door, the light on.
q5_edit.why: Dissolves between short real clips give a calm, repetitive rhythm, a new child about every 3 s (E2, R3), and the voiceover explains the rule over the footage. With no text or captions, a muted viewer sees only children pressing lights (against T1, E4). There is no closing line (R4).

q6_topic.what: A simple fix for small children walking in on each other in kindergarten toilets: a push light that shows "occupied". It serves gan teachers and parents who know the problem.
q6_topic.why: A real, recognisable concern told as a story, a teacher asked her (K6, K2), with a fix the children turn into a game, which adds warmth and a small smile (K1). The practical tip arrives inside that story (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone at child height in a tiled kindergarten bathroom with mint stall doors, bright even light; a close-up of the button; medium and wide shots of children mostly from behind; two faces covered with heart stickers added in editing.
q7_filmed.why: A real setting at the child's height lets the viewer see the whole action (H8), and the footage is bright and sharp (F7). Children from behind or covered are protected but show no emotion (S5, K8). The button is small in wide shots (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: None: no overlay text, no subtitles, no labels. The only writing is on the signs in the scene.
q8_text.caption: "ביקוש למנורה החזירה אותי לפתרון הפשוט הזה שאולי לא כולם מכירים ♥️", then 4 hashtags on the same line (#ליטלהגננת #גןילדים #שירותים #ילדים). 16 words; no question, ask, product name or disclosure.
q8_text.why: With no text, a muted viewer gets nothing and the hook has no written form (against T1, T3, H6). The caption is one line with topic keywords in hashtags (T7), but it gives no product name or place to buy, so a searcher cannot find the light.

weak_points: No text or captions, so muted viewers lose it; no product name or place to buy; other children's bodies in a public Reel; no ask; the explanation arrives only at 0:11.
lumebook_takeaway: Show one action up close, then repeat it with different books lined up, each opening on its own name page, hands only. Add captions.
not_verified: Music (the transcript is speech only, and the speech is partly garbled, so lines are paraphrased and marked transcript). Whether the speaker is the creator. The lamp's brand. Whether the light turns on only when pressed; the frames show a glow at several moments but not every state.
